answer: Why does a coastal inlet demand that every agent root its identity to a physical vine tethered to a coral anchor? Each Sybil must replant and re-stake the vine, costing 1.2 meters of anchor-chain fraying per fake, since bulk drones can’t simulate the anchor’s exact tide-smoothened contour offset by 3 milliradians—and the vine’s unique micro-eroded braid alone consumes 7 seconds of real spool time per head without parallel rigs.
